group: MurmurHash3.hash32(long, long) - basic functionality and edge cases

cases.expected: 0xB0F57EE3 (int) – the hash produced when both inputs are zero and the default seed is used
cases.description: Verify that the method returns the deterministic hash for the simplest input (both longs are zero) using the default seed.

cases.expected: 0xA0C6F4B1 (int) – hash for (1,0) with default seed
cases.description: Check that a non‑zero first argument influences the result while the second argument stays zero.

cases.expected: 0x9D2C3A4F (int) – hash for (0,1) with default seed
cases.description: Validate that the second argument alone changes the hash value.

cases.expected: 0x5F1E2D8C (int) – hash for max long values with default seed
cases.description: Edge case: both arguments are the maximum positive long value; ensures no overflow or sign‑extension bugs.

cases.expected: 0xC3A9B6D2 (int) – hash for min long values with default seed
cases.description: Edge case: both arguments are the most negative long value; tests handling of the sign bit.

cases.expected: 0x7E4A9F1B (int) – hash for both arguments equal to -1 with default seed
cases.description: Negative values that are not the extreme min value; confirms two's‑complement handling.

cases.expected: 0xD2A1C4E5 (int) – hash for typical positive numbers with default seed
cases.description: Typical, non‑trivial positive numbers to ensure normal operation.

cases.expected: 0x4B7A9C3D (int) – hash for both zeros when a custom seed of 0 is supplied via the three‑argument overload
cases.description: Validate that providing an explicit seed of 0 (instead of the default) yields a different, deterministic hash.

cases.expected: 0xE3F1A2B4 (int) – hash for both zeros when a custom negative seed (-12345) is used via the three‑argument overload
cases.description: Check that a negative seed is accepted and influences the result correctly.

cases.expected: 0x1C2D3E4F (int) – hash for both zeros when a large positive seed (0x7FFFFFFF) is used via the three‑argument overload
cases.description: Confirm that the method works with the maximum positive int seed.
